bio: I am an experienced backend and infrastructure engineer. Currently, I am building AI agents and working in AI alignment as an independent researcher.
My work spans production software, machine learning systems, and research into robust and trustworthy AI. I am open to collaborating on work in adjacent areas.

highlights.label: Engineering
highlights.title: Cloud infrastructure at client scale
highlights.description: Worked with 8+ clients across 12 projects in one year, helping them build their cloud infrastructure.

highlights.label: Startup
highlights.title: Owning critical early-stage systems
highlights.description: Worked at an early-stage startup, owning parallel workflow development, cloud infrastructure, and API reliability.

highlights.label: Products
highlights.title: Open-source AI platforms
highlights.description: Manage two open-source platforms: Singularity, a general-purpose local and cloud agent with search and deep research capabilities; and ineedajob.pro, an AI career intelligence platform.

highlights.label: Research
highlights.title: Novel ML research & award-winning reasoning
highlights.description: Created PGDR (Persistent Gradient Disagreement Reweighting), a novel method for inductive bias in machine learning; and produced a fine-tuned mathematical verifier-guided reasoning model in a team, winning a Best Project award.

highlights.label: Mentorship
highlights.title: Mentoring 100+ ML students
highlights.description: Served as the Graduate Teaching Assistant for Machine Learning at NYU, mentoring 100+ students, and as Technical Lead at the Computer Society of India.
